ecosystemRotation: agent-browser-control, diagnostics, desktop/mobile adapters, computer-use benchmarks

candidates.head: b0f99c6ce57584cfa58d2f9f0030d191729d3424
candidates.harvest: persistent Rust daemon, named sessions, versioned refs, atomic batch flows, live MCP resources, action cache, unified trace/HAR/visual/debug evidence, structured next-action envelopes
candidates.integrationMode: temporary protocol/subprocess adapter first; transplant proven patterns rather than replace Playwright blindly
candidates.expectedBenefit: fewer startup and agent round trips with stronger deterministic recovery and evidence
candidates.risk: young project and overlapping browser-control surface could add maintenance complexity
candidates.smallestExperiment: run the same Ferrum web and MV3 workload through an isolated gsd-browser-backed adapter
candidates.acceptance: same or higher success/evidence completeness with lower median/p95 elapsed time or fewer tool calls and zero regression in restart/runtime identity

candidates.version: current Tauri v2 testing guidance checked 2026-08-17
candidates.harvest: WebdriverIO Tauri service, embedded WebDriver, IPC mocking, frontend/backend logs and multiremote
candidates.expectedBenefit: first-class Tauri coverage rather than treating all desktop apps as Electron
candidates.risk: new target must share Ferrum lifecycle/evidence contracts and prove all supported host platforms individually
candidates.smallestExperiment: build a minimal Tauri fixture and run launch/interact/restart/log/evidence flow
candidates.acceptance: real packaged Tauri app passes launch, interaction, restart/persistence and evidence capture on a supported host

nextExperiments: Benchmark an isolated gsd-browser adapter against Ferrum's existing web+MV3 path using identical work, recording success, median/p95 elapsed time, agent/tool calls, restart proof and evidence completeness.
Prototype Electron compact delta snapshots plus one-call state envelopes inspired by Electron Stagewright, preserving full raw evidence.
Add tool-call/round-trip and evidence-completeness accounting to Ferrum benchmark reports before evaluating larger agent-control substitutions.
Prototype a real Tauri target adapter using current Tauri/WebdriverIO guidance after the browser-backend experiment, without changing existing Electron/Desktop paths.
guardrails: No reduced target coverage, skipped runtime proof, quality/fidelity loss, diagnostic loss, caps, viewport-only shortcuts, stale caching, or weaker tests.
New adapters remain additive until real-runtime parity and measurable improvement are proven.
Synthetic benchmarks supplement but never replace Ferrum's real Linux, Windows, browser matrix, MV3 restart, packaged desktop, Lightpanda and Android/Appium gates.
